findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_dns_record, domain_report, check_mail_policies, analyze_email_headers, trace_redirects, find_lookalikes, create_monitor, compare_domains · Private data: lookup_dns, lookup_whois, check_dnssec, check_migration, check_dangling_records, build_dns_record, validate_dkim_record, convert_idn, check_mail_policies, analyze_email_headers, verify_dkim_signature, lookup_ip, check_standard_files, find_lookalikes, export_expiry_calendar, decode_certificate, create_monitor · Public sink: audit_email, domain_report, check_mail_policies, analyze_email_headers, detect_tech_stack, find_lookalikes, create_monitor, compare_domains · Destructive: check_dangling_records, domain_report, trace_redirects, audit_accessibility, export_expiry_calendar, create_monitor, bulk_run, compare_domains.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
